description: Make an AI image: a product still, a thumbnail, a poster, concept art, or a reference frame to animate later. Requires a quote_id from estimate_credit_cost so the price is agreed first; then returns a job id to poll with get_generation (kind "image"). Credits are charged only when the image succeeds. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

image_url.description: Optional public reference image (image-to-image). Only these models accept one: gpt_image_2, gpt_image_2_edit, gpt_image_2_5_flare, gpt_image_2_5_sunburst, seedream_5_0_pro.

model.description: Image model ID from list_models with type "image". Must match the quoted model; omitted means the quoted model.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from estimate_credit_cost for this exact image model. Required.

name: generate_image

credits_quoted.description: The price fixed by the quote.

credits_used.description: 0 until the render succeeds; billing is post-deduct.

next_step.description: What to do next, in words, so a model need not infer it.

replayed.description: True when this quote_id had already been submitted and the original job was returned.
